name: GPU benchmarks (container)
purpose: glmark2 and vkmark in a container instead of on the host: localhost/powos-gpu-bench, built on the phone from its own KGSL Mesa (powos-gpu-bench build); run one with `powos-gpu-bench vk` (headless vkmark) or `powos-gpu-bench gl` (glmark2 on the session's Wayland). --rm, nothing stays running
installedBy: targets/android/containers/gpu-bench/powos-gpu-bench (by hand: adb push to /usr/local/bin, then powos-gpu-bench build)
